test_title: PYST 7 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

The girl **walked the dog, in a green dress.**

options.text: walk the dog, in a green dress
walking the dog, in a green dress
in a green dress, walked the dog
in a green dress, walking the dog

solution:
The correct answer is '**in a green dress, walked the dog**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The placement of the phrase "**in a green dress**" is crucial for the correct sentence structure and clarity.
 
• Option 3: "**in a green dress, walked the dog**" correctly places the modifying phrase "in a green dress" near the subject "The girl," ensuring the sentence is unambiguous.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and 4 are incorrect as they either imply the dog is wearing the dress or create an awkward sentence structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The girl, in a green dress, walked the dog."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "walk the dog, in a green dress"** is incorrect as it suggests the dog is wearing the dress.
 
• **Option 2: "walking the dog, in a green dress"** is incorrect as it changes the tense and meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "in a green dress, walking the dog"** is incorrect as it creates an incomplete and unclear sentence structure.
